newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit steady as interest ebbs; mkt awaits data.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit steady as interest ebbs; mkt awaits data.

text.p: The ringgit was bound to a tight range in afternoon trading as international interest in the currency ebbed due to holidays in Hong Kong and London, dealers said on Monday.

They said the market was waiting for new economic data from Malaysia -- trade figures for June, GDP growth in the first half of 1996 and money supply figures for July were eagerly awaited -- to set a direction for dollar/ringgit.
"It is month-end, Hong Kong and London are off. There is a certain holiday mood in the market," said the head of foreign exchange dealing at a Malaysian bank.
"The market is now looking for better (economic) figures," he said.
"Nothing much is happening. There is nothing new to trade on," said a dealer with a foreign bank in Kuala Lumpur.
He said there was little activity even in ringgit/Singapore dollar, which was in the unwinding mode last week.
Dealers said ringgit/Sing was headed down as investors were returning to "safe haven" Singapore dollar.
At 1600 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4930/35 per dollar against 2.4935/40 at close on Friday. The Singapore dollar was at 0.5649/54 against 0.5654/60. - Madhav Reddy (603-230 8911)
